title: seed.cloned@1
description: A run's database was cloned from its environment's seed template (#332). It carries the template's seed record, its source, when that source was copied and its migration revision, with the template's digest and when it was cloned. Only the core appends it.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

run.description: The run whose database it is: a run: handle.

stack.description: The stack run it was cloned for: a run: handle.

source.description: Where the seed copied its data from, as its record names it.

copied_at.description: When that source was copied, as its record gives it (ISO 8601).

migration.description: The migration revision the seeded database is at.

template.description: The SHA-256 of the template's bytes, in lower-case hex.

cloned_at.description: When it was cloned, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
